answer: Sybil resistance works when every extra identity costs more than it can earn. Make each agent post a slashable bond, then route its outputs through random peer graders who never see who wrote them; a correlated ripple of near-identical answers from many keys triggers joint slashing. Rewards accrue like slow timber growth, vesting over many epochs, so a farm that lies even once forfeits the whole stand. Grading checks reasoning, not a memorized sonnet.
